name: Hyperliquid
description: Hyperliquid is a decentralized perpetual exchange with best-in-class speed, liquidity, and price

governanceData.details: Can vote on HIPs (includes upgrades, treasury decisions, other network parameters)

holdersRevenueAndValueAccrual.primaryValueAccrual: Buybacks - Most protocol fees go to the assistance fund which buys back HYPE tokens

methodology.Fees: 1% of perp and spot trading revenue (excluding builders and unit revenue) share for HLP.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Fees going to governance token holders
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: All fees share of HLP are distributed to vaults suppliers.

methodology.Fees: Include perps trading fees and builders fees, excluding spot fees.
methodology.Revenue: 99% of fees go to Assistance Fund for buying HYPE tokens, excluding builders fees.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: 99% of fees go to Assistance Fund for buying HYPE tokens, excluding builders fees.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: 1% of fees go to HLP Vault suppliers, before 30 Aug 2025 it was 3% + fees for builders.

Fees.Perp Fees: Perp trade fees collected as revenue, excluding spot fee.
Fees.Builder Code Fees: Fees added on top by other platforms building on top of Hyperliquid.

Revenue.Perp Fees: 99% of perp trade fees, excluding spot fees and builders fees.

SupplySideRevenue.Builder Code Distribution: All extra fees added on top by builders are fully passed down to these platforms.
SupplySideRevenue.HLP: 1% of the perp trade fees go to HLP vault (used to be 3% before 30 Aug 2025)

HoldersRevenue.Token Buy Back: 99% of perp trade fees (excluding spot fees and builders fees) for buy back HYPE tokens.

methodology.Fees: Include spot trading fees and unit protocol fees, excluding perps fees.
methodology.Revenue: 99% of fees go to Assistance Fund for buying HYPE tokens, excluding unit protocol fees.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: 99% of fees go to Assistance Fund for buying HYPE tokens, excluding unit protocol fees.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: 1% of fees go to HLP Vault suppliers, before 30 Aug 2025 it was 3% + fees for unit protocol.

Fees.Spot Fees: Fees collected on all spot trades, excluding trades on markets with Unit assets (eg bridged BTC).
Fees.Spot fees on Unit markets: Fees from spot trades on markets that include an asset deployed by Unit, in these spot markets all fees go to Unit.

Revenue.Spot Fees: 99% of spot trade fees, excluding perp fees and unit protocol fees.

SupplySideRevenue.Unit Revenue: All fees earned on Unit spot markets go to Unit
SupplySideRevenue.HLP: 1% of the spot fees go to HLP vault (used to be 3% before 30 Aug 2025)

HoldersRevenue.Token Buy Back: 99% of spot trade fees (excluding perp fees and unit protocol fees) for buy back HYPE tokens.
